scenarios.name: Keep staged command order when clicking the target Name header

scenario_steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software with the Tools ribbon visible
the Ribbon customization dialog has an initially empty Part Tools custom panel
the user has staged "3D Annotations" followed by "2D Sketches"
the user clicks the custom panel list Name header twice
the custom panel list remains in this order:
the target indicates a pending change
no User Commands panel is displayed on the Tools ribbon
